analysis: Results have saturated. Most recipes score 0.996-1.0 on dev, which is a few designs out of 512. They are well above the 0.536 baseline mean. The remaining differences are seed noise. The failures were mainly cells reward with low entropy (t19, 0.869), heightmaps (0.84) and the oversized net that timed out. The iou_delta reward with bonus 5, gamma 0.99, gae 0.95, lr 0.001, and conv with gelu and layernorm is robust. Depth 2 or 3 both work. Extra epochs or width may give a slight edge, so the last round repeats the top candidates with small variations to check which holds up.

proposals.hypothesis: Noise repeat of t25 (depth 2, gelu, layernorm, 4 epochs, 8 minibatches, iou_delta) with a new seed. If it scores below 0.998, the 1.0 was luck and the cheaper 2-epoch recipe is equivalent.
Noise repeat of t26 (width 128, depth 2, 2 epochs) with a new seed. If it is again 1.0 or 0.998 or higher, extra width gives a reliable small edge. If it falls below 0.996, width does not help.

Run the depth 3 gelu layernorm recipe (t14/t16, which scored 1.0 twice) with a step penalty of 0.05 and entropy 0.01, to push toward efficient exact builds. If below 0.996, the 0.01 penalty is better.
Noise repeat of t16 (depth 3, gelu, layernorm, 2 epochs, 8 minibatches, lr 0.001) with rollout_len 32 for longer credit-assignment windows. If below 0.996, rollout 16 is better.
